note.zh: 同 key 覆盖 OpenAI 兼容对话与 Seedance 视频生成；示例为北京区域端点，其他区域替换域名。
note.en: One key covers OpenAI-compatible chat and Seedance video; example is the Beijing region endpoint.

note.zh: OpenAI 兼容端点；推荐 deepseek-flash（V4.1-Flash）或 deepseek-v4-pro。
note.en: OpenAI-compatible endpoint; try deepseek-flash (V4.1-Flash) or deepseek-v4-pro.

note.zh: OpenAI 兼容模式；推荐 qwen-max / qwen-plus，企业用户可换业务空间专属域名。
note.en: OpenAI-compatible mode; try qwen-max / qwen-plus. Enterprise users may switch to a workspace-specific domain.

note.zh: OpenAI 兼容托管平台；模型 ID 带前缀，如 deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash、deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro。
note.en: OpenAI-compatible hosting; model IDs are prefixed, e.g. deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Pro.

note.zh: OpenAI SDK 兼容；推荐 glm-5.3（旗舰）或 glm-5-flash（性价比）。
note.en: OpenAI SDK compatible; try glm-5.3 (flagship) or glm-5-flash (cost-effective).

note.zh: OpenAI 兼容端点；默认 kimi-k3，亦可用 kimi-k2.6 / kimi-k2.7-code。
note.en: OpenAI-compatible endpoint; default kimi-k3, also kimi-k2.6 / kimi-k2.7-code.

note.zh: 仅当 Ollama 与 TokenHub backend 同机部署（自托管/盒子形态）时可用；模型名按已 pull 的模型填写。
note.en: Only works when Ollama runs on the same host as the TokenHub backend (self-hosted/box). Use a model name you have pulled.
